## Void Deck 1.2.0

**Void Deck now updates itself.** Open the Void Deck panel in Quick Access and it tells you when a newer release exists:
a **New version available** row appears above the version, with an **Update now** button. Pressing it hands the release
`.zip` to Decky Loader, which shows its own confirmation dialog, installs the update and leaves Void Deck ready after a
Steam restart. The check runs once, quietly, about thirty seconds after Steam starts, so you also get a toast when a new
version has shipped — no more hunting for the Releases page. If Decky's install route is unavailable, the panel falls
back to opening the release page, so nothing ever dead-ends.

**Updates are verified when GitHub provides a digest.** The installer passes the release's SHA-256 to Decky when the
release publishes one, and skips the check rather than failing if it does not. The panel shows install progress
("Installing…") and, once Decky accepts the request, switches to **Update installed — restart Steam to finish**, so an
update is never offered twice for the same release.

**In Spanish too.** Every new string — the update row, the progress and installed states, the failure toast — ships in
both English and Spanish, like the rest of the panel.

**Install / update:** Decky → ⚙ → Developer → *Install Plugin from ZIP*, then select `VoidDeck-v1.2.0.zip` from this release.
